assertions.name: pr1811_div25_finding_confirmed_reverse_test
assertions.source: Reverse confirmation of PR #1811's central finding: swapping /25 (q=1 fibre) → /[5]_q² (q_0 archimedean) must DEGRADE the c_3 match (since /25 wins at proton anchor). This is the inverse of #1811's test and must agree with it. Sanity invariant.

description: Piece-by-piece fibre (q=1) vs archimedean (q=q_0) test of the c_3 closure. Extends PR #1811's finding (/25 is fibre-evaluated [5]_q² at q=1) to the other 5 categorical pieces. Reports which pieces (if any) also fit q=1 fibre evaluation, vs q_0 archimedean. Honest test of the mixed fibre/archimedean structural reading.

verdict.interpretation: c_3 closure structural reading: /25 is the unique testable fibre-point factor; all other testable pieces evaluate archimedean at q_0. (5 archimedean) × (1 fibre) tensor.
